info.title: Question Bank API
info.description:
REST API for a question bank: classes → subjects → chapters, question types and questions, plus paper generation and import/export.

**Encoding.** All text is UTF-8 (Arabic, Bengali, any Unicode) and is Unicode-normalised (NFC) on write. Send `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`.

**Question types.** Every subject owns its own list of types. A type has a free `name` and a `kind` (`mcq`, `true_false`, `text`) that decides how questions are validated.

**Errors.** Failures return `{"error": {"message": "..."}}` with status 400 (invalid input), 404, 409 (duplicate / in use), 413, 415 or 422.

**Same origin.** If a `frontend/` folder sits next to the server binary it is served at `/`; call the API with relative URLs. CORS is open.

logo.description: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, max 5 MB

delete.description: Also deletes its subjects, chapters, question types and questions.

get.summary: List the subjects of a class

post.summary: Create a subject in a class
post.description: The subject starts with the question types MCQ, True/False and Plain.

delete.description: Also deletes its chapters, question types and questions.
Its questions are kept and become chapter-less.

get.summary: List the question types of a subject

put.summary: Rename a type or change its kind
put.description: Changing `kind` is rejected (409) while questions use the type.

delete.description: Rejected (409) while questions use the type.

get.summary: List and filter the questions of a subject

post.description: Send JSON, or `multipart/form-data` to attach a figure (`image`). The type's `kind` decides what is required: `mcq` needs 4 options + `correct_option`, `true_false` needs `answer`, `text` needs nothing extra.

get.summary: Get a question (with answer and description)
Download an uploaded image (figure or logo)

post.description: Pick questions by hand (`question_ids`), randomly (`random`), or both. Random picking can be limited to several chapters and several question types, with counts per type or per chapter. A pool that is too small fails with 422 unless `allow_fewer` is true.

by_chapter.summary: 5 MCQ from each of three chapters

mixed.summary: Hand-picked + random fill from several types

get.description: `sqlite` is a complete database copy (including saved papers); `json`/`yml` use the portable document format.

parameters.name: include_files
parameters.description: JSON/YAML only: embed images as base64

schema.description: Same structure as the JSON document

post.description: The whole import runs in one transaction: if any record is invalid nothing is changed and the error names the offending record, e.g. `classes[0].subjects[1].questions[3]: ...`.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: `merge` adds what is missing and skips exact duplicate questions; `replace` first deletes all classes, subjects, chapters, types and questions

file.description: A `.json`, `.yml` or `.sqlite` export (including files from before chapters/types existed)

Error.description: Every error response has this shape.

InstituteUpdate.description: Send only what you want to change.

SubjectInput.description: A new subject automatically gets the default question types MCQ, True/False and Plain.

QuestionType.description: A question type owned by one subject. `name` is your label; `kind` decides how its questions are validated.

kind.description: `mcq` = 4 options + correct option; `true_false` = answer true/false; `text` = plain, optional model answer
Cannot be changed while questions use the type (409)

type_id.description: One of the subject's question types. Alternative to `type`.

type.description: Question type **name** (case-insensitive), or a kind (`mcq`, `true_false`, `text`) to use the subject's first type of that kind. If neither `type_id` nor `type` is sent, the subject's first `mcq` type is used.

chapter_id.description: Must belong to the same subject. `null` = no chapter.

text.description: Question text; may contain inline LaTeX such as `$x^2$`

answer.description: `true_false`: true/false (boolean, or text such as `true`, `yes`, `সত্য`, `মিথ্যা`, `صح`, `خطأ`). `text`: optional model answer. `mcq`: ignored; it is always the text of the correct option.

lang.description: Language code; `ar`, `fa`, `ur`, `he` are reported with `dir: rtl`

QuestionInput.description: At least one of `text`, `math` or an image is required.

type_id.description: One of the subject's question types. Alternative to `type`.

type.description: Question type **name** (case-insensitive), or a kind (`mcq`, `true_false`, `text`) to use the subject's first type of that kind. If neither `type_id` nor `type` is sent, the subject's first `mcq` type is used.

lang.description: Language code; `ar`, `fa`, `ur`, `he` are reported with `dir: rtl`

subject_id.description: Optional; must equal the question's current subject (questions cannot be moved).

remove_image.description: Remove the figure (ignored when a new image is uploaded)

QuestionUpdate.description: Partial update: omitted fields keep their stored values. Sending `type`/`type_id` re-validates the whole question against the new type.

text.description: Question text; may contain inline LaTeX such as `$x^2$`

lang.description: Language code; `ar`, `fa`, `ur`, `he` are reported with `dir: rtl`

image.description: Figure: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, max 5 MB (type is detected from the content)

answer.description: `mcq`: text of the correct option; `true_false`: `true`/`false`; `text`: model answer (may be empty)

Question.description: `correct_option`, `answer` and `description` are omitted from generated papers unless `include_answers` is true.

chapter_ids.description: Only questions of these chapters. `"none"` = questions without a chapter. One value or a list.

type_ids.description: Only these question types (ids). One value or a list.

kinds.description: Only these kinds. One value or a list.

types.description: Only types with these names (or kinds). One value or a list.

count.description: Total number to pick from the filtered pool (>= 1)

by_type.description: Count per question type. Key = type id, type name, or kind (`"MCQ"`, `"5"`, `"mcq"`).

by_chapter.description: Count per chapter. Key = chapter id or `"none"`.

allow_fewer.description: Return fewer questions instead of failing (422) when the pool is too small

RandomSpec.description: Random picking. Use **exactly one** of `count`, `by_type`, `by_chapter`. The filters narrow the pool first (OR inside a filter, AND between filters).

question_ids.description: Hand-picked questions, kept in this order and placed first

class_id.description: Scope of random picking: every subject of the class

shuffle_options.description: Shuffle MCQ options (the correct option is updated)

save.description: Store the paper (see `/api/papers`); the response then has an `id` and status 201

meta.description: Free-form data copied into the paper (date, duration, ...)

GenerateRequest.description: Provide `question_ids` and/or `random`. Random picks never repeat a question.

chapter.description: Chapter name; created on import if missing

Doc.description: Portable, id-independent export document (version 2). Version 1 documents (`type` = `mcq`/`text`, `explanation`) are still accepted on import.

Conflict.description: Duplicate name, or the resource is still in use

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body or image too large

UnsupportedMedia.description: Only PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP images are allowed

Unprocessable.description: Valid request, but it cannot be fulfilled (not enough questions, or an import record is invalid)
